title: Holdfast pack catalog (manifest.json)
description: The signed pack catalog the Holdfast app reads. Field names are camelCase. Required and optional fields match CatalogParser in the app (src/Holdfast.Core/Content/Catalog.cs): the parser requires schema and published at the root and id, version, url, sha256 and size on every pack, and gives every other field a documented default. This schema is deliberately STRICTER than the parser in one way: additionalProperties is false, so a misspelled field fails CI instead of silently taking its default on the phone.

_comment.description: Free-text note. Ignored by the app (unknown fields are skipped).

schema.description: Catalog schema number. 1 is the only version the app understands.

published.description: When this catalog was published, UTC: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The app falls back to this date for any pack without its own published date.

minAppVersion.description: Optional. Apps older than this ignore the whole catalog. Default when absent: 0.0.0.

packs.description: Every pack the app may install. The app installs nothing that is not listed here.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the whole file. 64 zeros is the repo's placeholder for 'not built yet'; validate_manifest.py reports it and the app's checksum check rejects every file against it.

id.description: Stable pack id. Also the folder name under packs/ and the on-device folder name.

name.description: Optional. Display name on the Packs screen. Default when absent: the id.

group.description: Optional. Grouping on the Packs screen. Default when absent: optional.

region.description: Optional. ISO 3166-2 region the pack covers, e.g. US-MD. null or absent means the pack is not region-specific.

version.description: Date-based pack version, yyyy.MM.dd. Newer versions must sort higher as ordinal strings.

published.description: Optional. yyyy-MM-dd. Default when absent: the catalog's published date. Drives the freshness label with staleAfterDays.

format.description: Optional. File format, which decides how the app opens the pack. Default when absent: hfdb.

size.description: Size of the whole file in bytes. The app discards a download whose size differs. 0 is the repo's placeholder for 'not built yet'.

url.description: Primary download URL. Tried first; then each mirror in order.

mirrors.description: Optional. Fallback URLs, tried in order after url. Moving a pack to new hosting is a one-line change here, with no app release.

delta.description: Optional. Patch from one older version. The MVP app downloads the full file and ignores this.

from.description: The installed version this delta applies to.

parts.description: Optional. For files over 2 GB: numbered parts, each with its own checksum, reassembled on the phone. Omit or leave empty when the file is whole.

required.description: Optional. True for a pack the app installs on first run and will not let the user remove. Default when absent: false.

staleAfterDays.description: Optional. Days after published before the pack gets an amber 'stale' badge. 0 means never stale. Default when absent: 0.

license.description: Optional. Licence of the pack contents, SPDX id where one fits. Shown on the pack's About screen. Default when absent: empty.

attribution.description: Optional. Credit line shown on the pack's About screen and, for maps, on the map. Required in practice for CC BY-SA and ODbL content.

changes.description: Optional. One line shown in the update list: what is new in this version.

minAppVersion.description: Optional. Apps older than this hide this pack. Raise it whenever the pack's file format changes. Default when absent: 0.0.0.

description.description: Optional extension. Short human description for the Packs screen.
